specSheet.title: Specifications and equipment
specSheet.intro: Figures come from the official EU configuration sheet (WVTA type approval). Pick a version to see its equipment.

rows.label: DC charging
rows.value: 40 kW · 30–80% in up to 20 min · 10–80% in up to 25 min

rows.label: Boot space
rows.value: 507 l · 1,314 l with the rear seat folded

rows.label: Exterior colours
rows.value: Emerald Green, Amethyst Violet, Pearl White, Obsidian Black, Silver Grey

items.essence: 8 airbags: front, front side, curtain, driver knee, driver far-side
items.elegance: 10 airbags, including driver knee, far-side and rear side

items.text: Lane departure warning and prevention, Emergency Lane Keeping
Blind spot detection (BSD) and Rear Cross Traffic Alert
Traffic Jam Assist (TJA) and intelligent speed limiter
Direct tyre pressure monitoring (TPMS), electric parking brake, AUTO HOLD
Automatic LED headlights, LED daytime running lights, LED tail lights
Ambient lighting in the second row
Multicolour ambient lighting and welcome lights in the sills
Dual-zone automatic climate control with PM0.3 filtration
Acoustic glass (windscreen and front doors), tinted rear windows

items.elegance: Graphite black or caramel brown interior

items.text: Both front seats heated, ventilated and with massage
Driver seat: 6-way power adjustment, power lumbar, memory
Negative-ion purification and air quality system (AQS)
13.2" HD vertical central screen and 10.25" instrument display
Voice control, phone mirroring, wireless charging

meta.title: LEPAS L6 PHEV – plug-in hybrid SUV
meta.description: The LEPAS L6 PHEV at LEPAS Brașov: a 279 hp plug-in hybrid SUV with up to 92 km electric and 1,058 km combined range (WLTP).

lepasL6Phev.name: LEPAS L6 PHEV
lepasL6Phev.subtitle: Electric in the city, carefree on long trips. 279 hp, up to 92 km on the battery alone and 1,058 km combined range (WLTP).

price.label: Launch price
price.note: incl. VAT · with a €1,000 deposit, until 30 November

interior.dashboard: A digital cockpit built around the driver
interior.rear: Room for everyone in the back

comfort.title: Elegant Comfort
comfort.text: The Drive Your Elegance philosophy continues inside: materials that feel good, controls within easy reach and a calm atmosphere that makes any journey feel shorter.
comfort.connectedText: A generous central screen and digital instruments: navigation, phone and music are one gesture away, without taking your eyes off the road.
comfort.spaceText: Five genuinely usable seats, with generous head and knee room and storage designed for everyday things.
comfort.lastingText: Supportive seats, careful sound insulation and a suspension tuned for comfort – from the daily commute to holiday trips.

power.title: Two sources of energy, one journey without breaks
power.text: The 1.5 turbo petrol engine works together with an electric system fed by an 18.4 kWh battery. In the city you drive electric; on long trips you don't need to plan your stops.
power.highlight1: Up to 92 km on electricity alone (WLTP) – the daily commute, without petrol
power.highlight2: Up to 1,058 km on one tank and one charge (WLTP)
power.highlight3: The battery charges from a socket while the car is parked
power.footnote: WLTP figures, EU type approval, Essence and Elegance versions. Consumption with a depleted battery: 5.9 l/100 km; electric energy consumption: 14.8 kWh/100 km. Real-world figures vary with conditions, driving style and battery charge.

cta.title: Start your LEPAS L6 PHEV experience
cta.text: Request an offer and a LEPAS Brașov consultant will call you with all the details: versions, price, financing and delivery.
